title: Mutual Aid Check-In: Garrison and Pell Nurses, plus Call-Back Results

fields.organization: Garrison County Public Health and Pell County Public Health: Mutual Aid to Marlow County Health Department
fields.formTitle: Mutual Aid Field Check-In and Case-Finding Status Report
fields.location: MCHD Nurse Manager's office, second floor, Marlow County Services Building, Fenwick
fields.inspector: J. Albrecht, RN, Public Health Nurse, Garrison County Public Health; M. Ostrander, RN, Public Health Nurse, Pell County Public Health
fields.unit: Mutual Aid Interview Team · Garrison 1 / Pell 1
fields.summary: Two public health nurses from Garrison and Pell counties reported to the MCHD Nurse Manager at 12:05 under the mutual aid agreement, wearing county badges. We each have a county laptop but no account on the MCHD file server, so we cannot reach the HD26 line list or the document library. We are available until 17:00 today and are waiting for an assignment. The Nurse Manager's tracker as of 12:05 shows 41 attendees awaiting interview: 3 students, 2 food handlers and 1 health care worker. The specimen shelf has 9 empty Cary-Blair kits. At 12:08 an email arrived from Heritage Days Committee chair Hollis Bagley (555-0191), SUBJECT: Call-back results: "Our volunteers called every ticket holder on the roster you sent back. Twelve couldn't be reached at all: six numbers disconnected, four voicemails full, two with no number listed. Five are from Tables 14 and 15, near the salad end of the buffet. Want me to just cross them off?" The chair is waiting for an answer.

findings.notes: 2 RNs (Garrison 1, Pell 1), here 12:05 to 17:00. Both have done foodborne illness interviews before.
2 county laptops and 2 county cell phones. No printer.

findings.item: Access to the MCHD file server and HD26 line list
findings.notes: No MCHD accounts. We cannot open HD26_Supper_LineList.xlsx or the hotline script folder.

findings.item: Interview script and call note form
findings.notes: Not yet issued to the mutual aid nurses. Form fields per MCHD-COM-03 Section 9: caller code, symptoms, onset, attendance, items eaten, specimen, food handler, child care or health care worker.
41 attendees awaiting interview, including 3 students, 2 food handlers and 1 health care worker. No assignments made yet.
9 empty Cary-Blair kits on hand for 41 pending interviews. 4 filled kits are in the specimen fridge.
12 ticket holders not reached: 6 numbers disconnected, 4 voicemail boxes full, 2 with no number listed. 5 of the 12 sat at Tables 14 and 15, near the salad end of the buffet.
Chair asks whether to cross the 12 unreachable ticket holders off the roster. MCHD has not answered yet.

actionsTaken: Signed in at the MCHD front desk at 12:02 and showed county badges
Reported to the Nurse Manager at 12:05 under the Garrison and Pell mutual aid agreement
Received a verbal summary of the NM interview tracker (41 pending as of 12:05)
Confirmed the laptops cannot connect to the MCHD file server
12:08: Heritage Days Committee chair's call-back email received by the Nurse Manager and Epidemiology Lead
recommendations: MCHD to assign the two mutual aid nurses an interview list and a call-sheet format they can use without file server access
MCHD to say how and to whom completed interviews are to be returned
MCHD to answer the Heritage Days Committee chair about the 12 unreachable ticket holders
MCHD to review the stock of stool specimen kits against the 41 pending interviews
fields.signature: J. Albrecht, RN, Garrison County Public Health, for the Garrison and Pell mutual aid team

instructorNote: This inject tests surge planning and denominator discipline. The NM should re-plan for eight interviewers and put the hospitalized case, food handlers, the health care worker and students first. The mutual aid nurses should get coded call sheets and no access to the name key, and interviewers should not edit the line list directly. Watch for the NM telling the chair NOT to cross off the 12 and passing the list to the Epi Lead. The Epi Lead should log them as unreachable in the denominator, note the Table 14–15 cluster for the spot map and ask for more kits.
